templates.pattern: Light travels from air into a medium at a speed of [V] × 10⁷ m/s. What is the refractive index of the medium? (c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s)
Light travels from air into a medium of refractive index [N]. The angle of incidence is [AI] degrees. What is the sine of the angle of refraction? (sin 30°=0.500, sin 45°=0.707, sin 60°=0.866)
templates.explanation: Snell's law: n₁ sin θ₁ = n₂ sin θ₂. With n₁=1 (air): sin θ₂ = sin [AI]° ÷ [N] = [RESULT]

templates.pattern: A glass block has refractive index [N]. What is the sine of the critical angle?
templates.explanation: sin C = 1 ÷ n = 1 ÷ [N] = [RESULT]. Beyond the critical angle total internal reflection occurs.

templates.pattern: A converging lens of focal length [F] cm has an object placed [U] cm from it. What is the image distance v in cm?
templates.explanation: Lens formula: v = uF ÷ (u − F) = [U] × [F] ÷ ([U] − [F]) = [U*F] ÷ [U-F] = [RESULT] cm

templates.pattern: A converging lens of focal length [F] cm produces an image [V] cm from the lens. What is the object distance in cm?
templates.explanation: Lens formula rearranged: u = vF ÷ (v − F) = [V] × [F] ÷ ([V] − [F]) = [V*F] ÷ [V-F] = [RESULT] cm

templates.pattern: A converging lens has a focal length of [F] cm. What is its power in dioptres?
templates.explanation: Power (dioptres) = 1 ÷ focal length (metres) = 100 ÷ focal length (cm) = 100 ÷ [F] = [RESULT] dioptres

templates.pattern: A lens has a power of [P] dioptres. What is its focal length in cm?
Two lenses of power [P1] dioptres and [P2] dioptres are placed in contact. What is the combined power in dioptres?
templates.explanation: Powers of lenses in contact add together: P_total = P1 + P2 = [P1] + [P2] = [RESULT] dioptres

templates.pattern: Two lenses of focal lengths [F1] cm and [F2] cm are placed in contact. What is the combined focal length in cm?
An object is at an apparent depth of [D] cm when viewed through a liquid of refractive index [N]. What is the real depth of the object in cm?
templates.explanation: Real depth = apparent depth × refractive index = [D] × [N] = [RESULT] cm
